install.userOwnedExclusion: Only the managed pipeline skill tree and installer-owned commands/pipeline/ TypeScript command are removed on uninstall. Sibling OMP commands, project .omp directories, and named OMP profile agent dirs (~/.omp/profiles/<name>/agent) are preserved. The OMP install base is never relocated via an environment variable.
install.postInstall: Invoke with /pipeline (native TypeScript command execs the installed launcher). Skill path: ~/.omp/agent/skills/pipeline. Restart OMP if commands do not appear live. Project .omp is not installer-managed.

early_run_handoff.how: Parse durable run handoff JSON from launcher stdout for run_id and events path.

event_follow.how: pipeline logs <run-id> --events --follow until terminal (portable CLI, including detach).

reattach.how: Re-arm event follow after cancelled wait; cancelled wait is not terminal.

wait_cancel.how: Cancelled wait is non-terminal; re-follow events until terminal.

material_progress_notify.how: Prefer material-filtered events.jsonl observation; host-native OMP notify is not required.
material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout material lines via events.jsonl + material-filter.mjs (portable baseline)

terminal_cleanup.how: Stop follows for this run_id on terminal.
